title: SECOM run record
description: One production run, as published by the replay producer onto the stream. See docs/record-contract.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Bumped on any breaking change.

replay_id.description: Identifies one replay session. seq restarts at 0 for each new replay_id.

seq.description: Send sequence number within the replay session, starting at 0. A gap means a record was lost.

run_id.description: Row number of the run in secom.data, starting at 0. The record's identity: duplicates share a run_id.

sent_at.description: When the producer sent the record (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z). The event time used downstream.

original_ts.description: The run's timestamp in the original dataset (fab local time, no time zone). For reference only.

sensors.description: The 590 sensor readings in column order. null means the reading is missing (normal in SECOM).
